notes.title: Yuri Game Festival Sale Announcement
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33994611/59301dc04c4b99fa651b321570db37da7ecbfac7.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][b]Lingua Fleur: Lily[/b] is participating in the Yuri Game Festival organized by Windfield Games![/p][p]Alongside excellent titles that beautifully portray girls' emotions—like the acclaimed [b]Flowers[/b] series from innocent grey—we're thrilled to be part of this celebration.[/p][p][b]Lingua Fleur: Lily[/b]  tells the story of a protagonist who, influenced by a new friend, gradually comes to recognize and accept a past relationship that once defined her.[/p][p]Yuri works, which explore the various emotions between women, have become a distinct and beloved genre. However, everyone has different ideas about "what actually counts as a yuri work."[/p][p]Some think of cozy slice-of-life stories like [b]Is the Order a Rabbit?[/b] from Kirara. Others picture romance dramas dealing with same-sex relationship challenges like [b]Bloom Into You[/b].[/p][p]Regardless of the type, fans cherish seeing intimate interactions between characters. But in real life, many more people feel confused, conflicted, and frustrated about emotions that differ from the majority experience.[/p][p]If we portray these feelings from their earliest stages—does that make it a yuri work?[/p][p]These were thoughts I had even before release, and judging by reviews over the past few years, I'm delighted to see many people who share our perspective have left their impressions.[/p][p]For this festival, the organizers have labeled our game as a "more unique kind of 'yuri' game" to help avoid disappointing players expecting purely sweet romance who might accidentally purchase something that doesn't match their preferences.[/p][p]So—is this a yuri game? We'd genuinely love to hear what you think.[/p]

notes.title: "Alice's World" Steam Page released, the girl hears "your" voice from in front of the screen
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/bcb8ac1e2aa0c4c98220fb152a0303ecce06e954.png[/img]
Alice's World is a story-driven 2D adventure puzzle game.
The girl opens her eyes in a desolate world, and hears "your" voice from in front of the screen.
You can direct her actions, help her solve mysteries, evade dangers, and find a way to leave this place. Of course, you could also choose not to do so, or even worse, deliberately guide her to death... Just kidding, you surely wouldn't do that, right?

[list][*]There is no role-playing! You are yourself, sitting in front of the screen, guiding the in-game character.

[*]Exquisite Japanese-style art and full voice acting bring an immersive experience.[/list]

Hello, players

In order to continue creating and releasing the "After Story" and to ensure a consistent style of artwork from one period to the next, we have invited the original illustrator to refurbish the character images in the game.

The refurbished images are more in line with their college age, and it is clear that the illustrator has grown over the years. This work is perhaps not only a product, but more like a collection of our work.

It seems that there are more and more works on this theme. And... our works also have their own small squares!

This work focusing on the theme of "a feeling different from the majority", with delicate and elegant illustrations, and a complete voiceover, this is a visual novel that follows a girl trying to know herself and admit her own sexuality.

notes.title: Celebrate this day! 15% off for one week
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33994611/3d67f09ac4875295be2399d092a17aeb6ffa5910.png[/img]
Hello, everyone.
In Taiwan, where the development group is located, same-sex couples are now able to register their marriages (2019/05/24).
That is, our laws recognize that the same sex couples can form a family and have the same rights and obligations.

Many same-sex couples who are willing to support each other and spend the days ahead finally have legal safeguards today.

On this day to celebrate, this work "Lingua Fleur: Lily" will be 85% off!
The relationship between same sex and companionship will not suddenly get everyone's approval and blessing after only a night, but
through novels and other works, it may be possible for more people to know a little more about their feelings and difficulties.

If you or your friends are interested in this topic, please also help us introduce this work, thank you.
Finally, although this work is still a long way from getting returns on our costs, there will also be comics, electronic fiction, DLCs, and other ways to spread our story. The music of the last words has yet to be played for this story, so we will continue playing as long as our instruments allow.

After all, real life has ushered in good end, so the characters in the story should also have a final ending to them. Stay tuned for our updates!

notes.title: About OST price adjustment
notes.notes:
Hello everyone:

Thanks for your reviews to tell us how you love for this music of game. The main composer of this work, "Oli Jan", has participated in many Narrator works, from "7 days with Death", "koi musubi" to "A Light in the Dark" "Lingua Fleur: Lily", you can hear the excellent songs he made.

During this time, he also got a degree from the University of Edinburgh School of Music, and accumulated a wealth of performance and composition experience. If you like his work, you can go to his personal [url=http://www.olijan.com/]website[/url].

At present, the price of the game music collection is much lower than the price of other online music (1 song / 1 USD). At first we wanted to make it easier for players who like our works to purchase peripheral products, but we found that this may be It is difficult for us to continue to make more works.....

After discussing with Oli Jan, we decided to refer to the 30% discount on the price of online music, and slightly increase the price of the "Flower: Lily" music collection (US$5.99), music Half of the proceeds from the collection will be distributed to the composer.

At present, we have applied for a document with a change in the price, which is expected to take effect within 1-2 days.

The fuel that a creator needs is not only enthusiasm, but also the cost of supporting life. Thank you for your purchase and introduction so that we can continue to make more works.

notes.title: Last night before release
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone. I am the producer of this work, Chang Yi.
On the Last eve before release, I want to talk about the reason for why making this work.

After our work 'koi musubi' released on Steam, Some player ask us about an English version.
Unfortunately, 'koi musubi' is about 200,000 words, we are unable to pay for these translation costs.
(BTW, thanks for Translation volunteer, Woosk and editer Josh, they help us so much.)
So, we decided to make a short visual novel and try to support English at frist.

About the theme of this work 'yuri', there are many different definitions.
Someone focus on the lovely life between girls.
Someone focus on the love troubles between girls.
But in reality -Perhaps especially in the East-, more they feel confused and frustrated about their feelings, I think.

We're thinking about if we describe this kind of emotion from an earlier stage, is this a 'yuri' game?
Some team numbers say 'YES', but some numbers say 'NO'.
For me, I want to make more people try to understand their disquiet,
more they know here are someone try to understand their disquiet,
I hope so.
